2027 Statewide Strategic Plan
8/8/2019-9/30/2027
Guiding Principles
Guiding Principles Definitions (the Strategic Plan's foundation)
SPROVE PERFORMANCE
WHOLE CHITO
ELIMINATE GAPS
EQUITY
PREPARE EDUCATORS
Whole Child:
o Every student enters school healthy and learns to practice a healthy lifestyle.
o Every student learns in an environment that is physically and emotionally safe.
o Every student actively learns, connects with their school, and engages in their broader community.
o Every student has access to personalized learning and support from qualified, caring adults.
o Every student is challenged academically and prepared for success in college or further and for
employment and participation in a global environment.
